headers.//: Everything except the embeddable widget route. X-Frame-Options: DENY is correct here - the dashboard holds an authenticated session and must never be framed.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://unpkg.com https://api.qrserver.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://newsletter-core.vercel.app https://*.brod3000.com https://*.openstreetmap.org https://*.basemaps.cartocdn.com https://*.cloudflare.com https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org https://api.zippopotam.us https://ip-api.com https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://api.qrserver.com; frame-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; frame-ancestors 'none'

headers.//: The widget route exists to be embedded in other people's websites, so it is the one path that must be framable by any origin. The blanket X-Frame-Options: DENY above used to apply here too, which meant no customer could ever embed a widget anywhere - the iframe was refused by the browser before the form was even fetched. It is omitted rather than relaxed, because X-Frame-Options has no wildcard: ALLOW-FROM is dead in every current browser, so frame-ancestors is the only directive that can express 'anyone'. Safe because this page carries no authenticated session; it is a public form on an origin whose storage a framing parent cannot read.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://newsletter-core.vercel.app https://*.brod3000.com https://challenges.cloudflare.com; frame-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; frame-ancestors *
